arms.free: no mode requirement, but beta <=0.70, speed >=4 m/s, and common road/actuator constraints
arms.grip: beta <=0.12 through pass, speed >=4 m/s, common road/actuator constraints
arms.required_slide: four consecutive frames with beta in [0.20,0.60], rear slip >=0.15, speed >=4 m/s, onset front before the OBB near face; beta never exceeds 0.70 through pass

claim_boundary: finite-domain detailed-model adjudication supporting or falsifying the bounded theorem bridge; not a universal vehicle theorem

decision_rule.falsify: any valid required-slide or early-slide free arm beats grip by more than 0.25 m
decision_rule.inconclusive: any arm-completeness, free-consistency, telemetry, or replay gate fails
decision_rule.support: all health gates and all planar plus Chrono no-drift-advantage gates pass

geometry.contact_rule: controlled-slide onset vehicle-front projection must not cross obstacle near face

metric.d_star: minimum obstacle-center distance cleared by a mode-valid trajectory; smaller is better

out_of_scope: rear steering or direct yaw moment enabled only in slide

positive_and_health_gates.all_arms_complete: every cell has finite D* for grip, required_slide, and free
positive_and_health_gates.chrono_exact_replay: best action sequence replays with <=1e-12 max state/telemetry error
positive_and_health_gates.chrono_local_frame: every stored Chrono trajectory starts exactly at local (0,0,0)
positive_and_health_gates.free_consistency: free D* <= min(grip D*, slide D*) +0.25 m in every cell
positive_and_health_gates.free_counterexample: no early-controlled-slide free solution beats grip by >0.25 m
positive_and_health_gates.no_drift_advantage: grip D* <= slide D* +0.25 m in every cell

primary_claim: Within the frozen lane-aligned static-OBB domain, the minimum clearable distance of the matched grip arm is no larger than that of the required controlled-slide arm, up to 0.25 m search/refinement tolerance.
